climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Riesling, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon and Cabernet Franc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Nebbiolo is at its cool limit. In cool years it can stay underripe, with green, sharp flavors.
Dolcetto is at its cool limit. In cool years it can stay underripe, with green, sharp flavors.

soil.rock: Granite weathers to coarse, acid, free-draining soil that warms quickly and holds heat. Its acidity tends to lower the grapes' acidity, which suits Gamay.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.
